Dear [Recipient’s Name],  

I had the pleasure of working with Jasmine Kaur during her time as a student in my Web Development course. She stood out for her ability to balance technical precision with a deep commitment to user experience, all while maintaining a collaborative and driven mindset.  

Jasmine’s work with React and Next.js enabled her to build scalable, responsive interfaces that adapted seamlessly across devices. Her attention to detail in implementing Web accessibility standards—ensuring compliance with WCAG guidelines—was particularly impressive. She approached challenges like improving keyboard navigation or contrast ratios with both technical rigor and an empathetic understanding of user needs. Her proficiency with Webpack and Vite allowed her to streamline build processes, and her use of TypeScript introduced clarity and reliability to complex codebases.  

One notable example came during a group project where Jasmine led the development of a SaaS dashboard. She leveraged React to create a dynamic, responsive layout while using Next.js to optimize performance. Her insistence on conducting accessibility audits before finalizing the design ensured the platform met industry standards. She also refined Webpack configurations to reduce build times by 30%, a detail that significantly improved the team’s workflow.  

Jasmine is a capable and dedicated professional. Her technical skills, paired with a genuine passion for creating inclusive digital experiences, make her a strong candidate. I wholeheartedly recommend her without reservation.  

Sincerely,  
[Professor’s Full Name]  
[University/Institution Name]  
[Contact Information]
